name: Friendship
content:
# Unit 1 · Friendship

## Kalıplar
* **Davet etme:** *Would you like to come to my party? / Do you want to join us?*
* **Kabul etme:** *Sure, I'd love to. / That sounds great!*
* **Reddetme ve bahane:** *Sorry, I can't. I have to study for my exam. / I'd love to, but I'm busy.*
* **Özür dileme:** *I'm sorry for being late. / I apologize.*
* **İyi bir arkadaşın özellikleri:** *A good friend is honest, supportive and trustworthy. He/She keeps secrets and shares things.*

## İpucu
“I'd love to, **but** …” ile başlayan cümle **reddetme** bildirir; “but” sonrasındaki bahaneye dikkat edin.

name: Teen Life
content:
# Unit 2 · Teen Life

## Beğeni ve tercih bildirme
* **Like / love / enjoy / be fond of / be keen on + V-ing:** *I enjoy playing chess. She is fond of reading.*
* **Dislike / hate / can't stand + V-ing:** *I can't stand waiting in queues.*
* **Prefer A to B:** *I prefer swimming to running.*
* **Sıklık zarfları:** *always > usually > often > sometimes > rarely/seldom > never*
  * *He **never** eats fast food.* (hiçbir zaman)

## Günlük rutinler
*get up, have breakfast, hang out with friends, go shopping, surf the Internet, do homework*

## İpucu
Tablo ve grafik sorularında sıklık zarflarını sayılarla eşleştirin: 7/7 gün = always, 0 gün = never.

name: In the Kitchen
content:
# Unit 3 · In the Kitchen

## Süreç anlatma (tarif)
* **Sıralama sözcükleri:** *First, … Then / Next, … After that, … Finally, …*
* **Mutfak fiilleri:** *chop (doğramak), slice (dilimlemek), boil (kaynatmak), fry (kızartmak), bake (fırında pişirmek), mix/stir (karıştırmak), pour (dökmek), add (eklemek), peel (soymak), grate (rendelemek)*
* **Ölçü ifadeleri:** *a cup of, a teaspoon of, a pinch of salt, two slices of bread*
* **Edilgen (passive) yapıyla tarif:** *The potatoes **are peeled** and **chopped**.*

## İpucu
Tarif sorularında bir adımın öncesinde ve sonrasında ne yapıldığını sıralama sözcüklerinden bulun.

name: On the Phone
content:
# Unit 4 · On the Phone

## Telefon konuşması kalıpları
* **Arama:** *Hello, this is Emre. Can I speak to Selin, please?*
* **Bekletme:** *Hold on, please. / Just a moment.*
* **Kişi yoksa:** *Sorry, she isn't here at the moment. Would you like to leave a message?*
* **Mesaj bırakma:** *Can you tell her to call me back?*
* **Hat sorunları:** *The line is busy. / I can't hear you, the line is bad.*
* **Kapanış:** *Talk to you later. / Bye for now.*

## Gelecek planları
*I'm going to visit my grandparents.* · *I'll call you back later.*

## İpucu
“Who's calling?” sorusu arayan kişinin kim olduğunu, “Can I take a message?” ise mesaj almak isteğini bildirir.

name: The Internet
content:
# Unit 5 · The Internet

## Kavramlar
*download, upload, log in, sign up, password, account, attachment, search engine, online shopping, social media, cyberbullying*

## Kabul/ret ve öneri
* *Why don't we search it online? – Good idea!*
* *How about sending an e-mail? – No, I'd rather call him.*

## İnternet güvenliği
* *Never share your password with anyone.*
* *Don't open e-mails from strangers.*
* *Use strong passwords with letters, numbers and symbols.*
* *Tell an adult if someone bothers you online.*

## İpucu
Grafik/ankete dayalı sorularda yüzdeleri dikkatle karşılaştırın; *most of* = çoğu, *a few* = birkaç, *none of* = hiçbiri.

name: Adventures
content:
# Unit 6 · Adventures

## Karşılaştırma
* **Comparative:** *Rafting is **more exciting than** hiking. A bike is **faster than** walking.*
* **Superlative:** *Bungee jumping is **the most dangerous** activity. Everest is **the highest** mountain.*
* Düzensiz: *good → better → the best · bad → worse → the worst*

## Tercih
* *I'd rather go camping than stay at home.*
* *I prefer canoeing to skydiving.*

## Macera sporları
*rafting, canoeing, scuba diving, paragliding, skydiving, bungee jumping, rock climbing, trekking*

## İpucu
Tablolarda “cost, risk, duration” gibi sütunları karşılaştırırken sıfatın comparative (iki şey) mı superlative (üç ve üzeri) mi olduğuna bakın.

name: Tourism
content:
# Unit 7 · Tourism

## Deneyim anlatma (Present Perfect)
* *Have you ever been to Cappadocia? – Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.*
* *I have visited Ephesus twice.*

## Yer tarifi ve öneri
* *You should visit the museum. It's worth seeing.*
* *The hotel is next to the beach. It is famous for its seafood.*

## Kelimeler
*accommodation, sightseeing, souvenir, guided tour, historical site, landscape, travel agency, passport, luggage*

## İpucu
“ever / never / already / yet / just” sözcükleri Present Perfect ile kullanılır.

name: Chores
content:
# Unit 8 · Chores

## Sorumluluk ve zorunluluk
* **have to / has to:** *I have to make my bed every morning.*
* **don't have to:** zorunlu değil — *You don't have to wash the dishes today.*
* **must / mustn't:** *You must be careful. You mustn't touch the stove.* (yasak)

## Ev işleri
*do the laundry, iron the clothes, vacuum the carpet, dust the furniture, set/clear the table, take out the rubbish, feed the pet, water the plants, tidy up the room*

## Şikâyet ve rica
* *I hate ironing.* · *Could you help me with the dishes?*

## İpucu
“don't have to” (gerek yok) ile “mustn't” (yasak) anlamca farklıdır.

name: Science
content:
# Unit 9 · Science

## Bilim ve buluşlar
* **Simple Past Passive:** *The telephone **was invented** by Alexander Graham Bell. Penicillin **was discovered** in 1928.*
* **Present Perfect:** *Scientists **have found** a new species. Technology **has changed** our lives.*

## Bilimsel süreç
*observe, hypothesis, experiment, result, conclusion, laboratory, microscope, invention, discovery*

## Ünlü bilim insanları ve buluşlar
* *Marie Curie — radioactivity research* · *Thomas Edison — light bulb (improved design)* · *Aziz Sancar — Nobel Prize in Chemistry (2015) for DNA repair research*

## İpucu
“was/were + V3” yapısı edilgen geçmiş zaman; işi yapan “by” ile verilir.

name: Natural Forces
content:
# Unit 10 · Natural Forces

## Doğal afetler
*earthquake, flood, landslide, avalanche, drought, wildfire, storm, tsunami, volcanic eruption*

## Tahmin ve sonuç (will / if)
* *If we cut down trees, there **will be** more floods.*
* *Scientists predict that sea levels **will rise**.*

## Afet anında yapılacaklar
* *During an earthquake, drop, cover and hold on.*
* *Prepare an emergency kit: water, a torch, a first-aid kit.*
* *Don't use the lift during a fire.*

## Çevre
*global warming, climate change, pollution, renewable energy, recycle, reduce, reuse*

## İpucu
Neden–sonuç sorularında “because, so, as a result, due to” bağlaçlarına dikkat edin.
